title: Long Product Sync (2.5 mins)
reference_transcript: Haan toh basically kal ka jo project sync tha, usmein humne thoda sa discuss kiya ki app ka current status kya hai aur next week tak humein exactly kya complete karna hai. Abhi backend ka major part almost done hai, but transcription pipeline mein thoda latency issue aa raha hai. Kabhi kabhi audio upload karne ke baad transcript aane mein thirty-forty seconds lag rahe hain, which is okay for a prototype, but production mein itna delay nahi hona chahiye. Rohit ne bola ki woh aaj evening tak check karega ki processing ko background job mein shift kar sakte hain ya nahi. Agar woh possible hai, toh user ko ek loading state dikha denge instead of making them wait on the same screen. Maine bola ki haan, ye better approach hai. Frontend side pe Neha ko summary aur action items ka UI finalize karna hai. Abhi cards thode basic hain, toh ideally summary ek separate section mein ho aur action items checkbox ke saath dikhein. Important ye hai ki agar action item mein deadline ya kisi person ka naam mention ho, toh woh bhi extract ho jaye. For example, agar koi bolta hai Amit ko Friday tak client ko email karna hai, toh output mein owner Amit, task client ko email karna, aur due date Friday aana chahiye. Ek aur cheez, humein Hinglish ke liye testing aur karni padegi because kuch recordings mein English aur Hindi sentence ke beech mein switching kaafi frequent hai. Maine do sample recordings already share kar di hain, but Priya ko aur at least five recordings collect karke deni hain, preferably different accents aur different speaking speeds ke saath. Marketing wala part abhi hold pe rakho because product flow stable hone ke baad hi landing page copy finalize karna useful hoga. So immediate priority backend latency, action-item extraction, aur frontend UI hai. Aaj ke end tak Rohit latency ka update dega, Neha latest UI screenshot share karegi, aur Priya testing ke liye additional recordings upload karegi. Main meanwhile extraction prompt ko improve karunga aur specifically dates, names aur tasks ko structured format mein nikalne ki koshish karunga. Aur haan, kal subah eleven baje ek short fifteen-minute sync rakh lete hain. Usmein bas blockers discuss karenge, koi long meeting nahi. Agar sab green hai toh directly implementation continue karenge.
expected_actions: Rohit to investigate shifting processing to a background job by evening
Neha to finalize Summary and Action Items UI with checkboxes
Priya to collect at least 5 additional recordings for testing
Improve extraction prompt for dates, names, and tasks
Hold off on marketing until product flow stabilizes
Attend 15-minute sync tomorrow at 11 AM
